tools.name: continuity_audit
tools.title: continuity audit
tools.description: Returns locked canon and style_drift for a short proposed scene. style_drift flags a POV or tense switch, or a banned phrase, when locked writing style states them on labeled lines (POV:, Tense:, Banned:). It does not judge tone or story type, save the scene, or approve it. Other contradictions still need comparison against locked_canon.

tools.name: create_story_project
tools.title: create story project
tools.description: Creates a new private story project requested by the user. Does not save canon or scenes.

tools.name: get_canon_history
tools.title: get canon history
tools.description: Returns previous and new content for a saved canon entry, newest first, without changing data.

tools.name: get_continuity_context
tools.title: get continuity context
tools.description: Retrieves relevant canon, story-level tone, story type, and writing style, recent approved scenes, and the latest provisional checkpoint. The request parameter is a brief scene or topic query, not a chat transcript. story_level is the whole project and is returned again when the latest checkpoint is resumed. Ranked canon is a selection, not the complete story bible.

tools.name: list_approved_scenes
tools.title: list approved scenes
tools.description: Lists approved scene summaries in story order with offset-based pagination.

tools.name: list_story_checkpoints
tools.title: list story checkpoints
tools.description: Returns provisional checkpoints and the project's story-level tone, story type, and writing style, so resuming a checkpoint keeps those categories. Checkpoints remain notes and do not approve or revise canon. The result is {checkpoints, story_level, guidance}. Page older checkpoints with offset; story_level is included on every page.

tools.name: list_story_projects
tools.title: list story projects
tools.description: Lists the authenticated user's saved story projects with their IDs and offset-based pagination.

tools.name: record_approved_scene
tools.title: record approved scene
tools.description: Stores a concise summary of a user-approved scene. An occupied scene number is preserved unless replaceExisting is true for a user-requested replacement. Identical retries return the saved scene.

tools.name: save_story_checkpoint
tools.title: save story checkpoint
tools.description: Saves user-authorized story progress as provisional notes, separate from canon, approved scenes, tone, story type, and writing style. Accepts focused story state, unresolved ideas, and next steps rather than full transcripts or unrelated personal data. The same checkpointId makes retries idempotent.

tools.name: search_story_canon
tools.title: search story canon
tools.description: Searches saved canon by literal title or content text. An empty query browses entries with offset-based pagination.

tools.name: upsert_canon_entry
tools.title: upsert canon entry
tools.description: Saves user-approved facts or canon revisions, including story-level TONE, STORY_TYPE, and WRITING_STYLE. TONE is mood. STORY_TYPE is genre, audience, and format. WRITING_STYLE is POV, tense, voice, dialogue, banned phrases, and approved examples; put parseable lines in content such as 'POV: third person limited', 'Tense: past', and 'Banned: very, suddenly'. LOCKED entries change only after the author approves them. Existing entries require their current expectedRevision; conflicting edits fail without overwriting. Identical retries preserve revision history.

canon.description: false marks a temporary, alternate, or what-if entry as non-canon. Omit to keep the current value; new entries default to canon.

expiresAt.description: Optional ISO 8601 date or datetime after which a non-canon or temporary entry expires. Omit to keep, null to clear.
